Use chemical symbols and formulae to identify elements and compounds.

engage.title: ONE LETTER
engage.hook: CO is a poisonous gas. Co is a metal used in magnets. How can one small letter change everything?

reveal.question: Look at the capital letters.
reveal.answer: Co is one element, cobalt. CO is a compound: one carbon atom (C) bonded to one oxygen atom (O). A new capital letter means a new element.

items: The smallest part of an element that can exist.
A substance made of only ONE type of atom.
Over 100 of them, all in the periodic table.
Compound: two or more elements chemically combined (bonded) in fixed proportions.
Chemical reaction: forms one or more NEW substances, often with an energy change.
Every element has a symbol. The first letter is always a capital; any second letter is lower case.
C carbon · Co cobalt · O oxygen · Na sodium (Latin natrium) · K potassium (Latin kalium)
Each capital letter starts a new element.
A small number after a symbol counts the atoms before it: H_2O = 2 hydrogen + 1 oxygen.
CO_2 = 1 carbon + 2 oxygen atoms (3 atoms, 2 elements).
One type of atom (O_2, Fe, He) = element.
Two or more elements bonded (H_2O, NaCl, CO_2) = compound.

options: A. A substance made of only one type of atom
B. Two or more elements chemically combined
C. Two substances mixed but not bonded
D. The smallest part of a compound
build.explanation: An element contains only one type of atom.
build.commonError: Choosing B, which describes a compound.

build.q: Which of these is a compound?
build.explanation: H_2O contains two elements, hydrogen and oxygen, bonded together.
build.commonError: Choosing O_2 because it has two atoms; both atoms are oxygen, so it is an element.

build.q: How many atoms are in one CO_2 molecule?
build.commonError: Answering 2 by counting the elements, not the atoms.

build.q: What is the difference between Co and CO?
options: B. Co is the element cobalt; CO is a compound of carbon and oxygen.
C. Co is a compound; CO is an element.
D. CO is cobalt written in capitals.
build.explanation: A new capital letter means a new element, so CO contains C and O.

build.q: Which of these shows a chemical reaction has happened?
options: C. A new substance forms and gives off heat.
D. Water is poured into a different shaped glass.
build.explanation: A chemical reaction makes a new substance, often with an energy change.
build.commonError: Thinking melting or dissolving makes a new substance.

build.q: What is the chemical symbol for sodium?
build.explanation: Na comes from its Latin name, natrium.
build.commonError: Using the first letters of the English name.

worked.prompt: How many atoms of each element are in H_2SO_4?
steps: Split at each capital letter: H_2 · S · O_4
O_4 = 4 oxygen atoms. Total = 7 atoms of 3 elements

yourTurn.prompt: How many atoms of each element are in CaCO_3?
yourTurn.answer: 1 calcium, 1 carbon, 3 oxygen = 5 atoms of 3 elements

statements.text: O_2 is a compound because it has two atoms.
statements.correction: Both atoms are oxygen, so O_2 is an element.

statements.text: A compound has different properties from the elements it is made from.
Melting ice is a chemical reaction.
statements.correction: No new substance forms; it is a physical change.

statements.text: In a symbol, the second letter is always lower case.

developing.q: Define the terms atom, element and compound.
developing.a: Atom: the smallest part of an element that can exist. Element: a substance made of only one type of atom. Compound: two or more elements chemically combined.

developing.q: Write the chemical symbols for carbon, oxygen and gold.
Sort these into elements and compounds: Fe, H_2O, O_2, NaCl.
developing.a: Elements: Fe, O_2. Compounds: H_2O, NaCl.

reaching.q: How many atoms of each element are in C_6H_12O_6 (glucose)?
Explain the difference between Co and CO.
reaching.a: Co is one element, cobalt. CO contains two capital letters, so two elements, carbon and oxygen, bonded together: it is a compound.

reaching.q: Iron and sulfur are heated together. A new black solid forms and glows. Explain how you know a chemical reaction has happened.
reaching.a: A new substance (iron sulfide) has formed with different properties, and energy is given out (it glows).

mastering.q: Water is a compound of hydrogen and oxygen. Explain why water has very different properties from hydrogen and oxygen.
mastering.a: The atoms are chemically bonded into a new substance, H_2O, with its own properties; the elements are no longer separate, so their properties do not carry over.

mastering.q: A sample of pure gas contains only O_2 molecules. A student says it is a compound because each molecule has two atoms. Evaluate this claim.
mastering.a: The student is wrong. Both atoms are oxygen, so the gas contains only one type of atom: it is an element. A compound needs two or more different elements bonded.

mastering.q: Calculate the total number of atoms in 2 molecules of H_2SO_4.
mastering.a: One molecule: 2 + 1 + 4 = 7 atoms. Two molecules: 14 atoms.
